column1: # Stage 3: evaluate tree-recursive FJ calls (not just root) across the first
# 16 nodes (--nodes=16, matching the user's "first 16 nodes" target), on top
# of the stage-1/stage-2 winner (--fj=on --fj-after-fpump=1, default
# effort-mult=1024/max-sol=1, both confirmed saturated in stage 2).
# Knobs swept:
#   --fj-depth=N          run FJ again every N tree levels (0 = root-call only)
#   --fj-only-no-sol=0|1  gate repeat FJ calls on "still no incumbent" (default 1)
# fj_root_only: baseline repeat (same as stage-1 winner, --nodes=16 here
# instead of 1, to see whether just letting B&B run 16 nodes on top changes
# anything by itself).
# fj_depth<N>_gated: only call FJ again while no solution has been found yet.
# fj_depth<N>_ungated: call FJ at every N-level checkpoint regardless (only
# worth testing to see if forcing extra calls ever helps/hurts once we DO
# have an incumbent -- expected neutral-to-worse per the user's own point).
fj_root_only
fj_depth2_gated
fj_depth4_gated
fj_depth8_gated
fj_depth2_ungated
fj_depth4_ungated
fj_depth8_ungated
